question: Act on Impulse exiles the top three cards of my library and lets me play them until end of turn. Do the cards I did not play go back to my library at end of turn?

expected.shortAnswer: No: the cards you do not play remain exiled.
expected.answer: Any cards you don't play will remain exiled.
